dedupe_keys.name: ig gird geospatial information for disaster risk management ign argentina

description: IG-GIRD is an interactive platform of the Argentine National Geographic Institute (IGN) that gathers and publishes geospatial information on disaster risk in Argentina, built with the RED GIRCYT network of scientific and technical bodies and in support of SINAGIR, the national system for integrated risk management and civil protection, and its monitoring and emergency system. It offers a web map viewer, OGC geoservices (WFS, WMS and WMTS), a download centre through the IGN GIS layers and a metadata section with a PDF sheet for each downloadable layer giving its source, year, format, attributes and restrictions. The layers are grouped into boundaries and regions; social vulnerability (for example health, census housing and population and social vulnerability indices for 2010, 2022 and 2024); hydrometeorological, geodynamic, physical-chemical and biological hazards; exposed infrastructure and operating structures; and the Anticipando la Crecida flood project for the Buenos Aires metropolitan area, the Luján and Areco rivers and the Paraná Delta. Access is free online under the IGN terms and conditions of use. Caveats: aerial photographs and elevation models can be viewed but not downloaded from the platform, and the site is in Spanish. Coverage is Argentina. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response analysis of infrastructure, with vulnerability layers for social impact; related records are the CONAE geoportal and the Mexico Atlas Nacional de Riesgos.
